# authwise_scim_token (Resource)

A bearer token a directory pushes users and groups with, for one `authwise_scim_connection`. kit creates it and returns it once, as `<id>_<secret>`, so **the token is kept in state**, marked sensitive: protect the state as you would the token, since anyone who reads it can write the realm's users. Paste `secret` into the directory with the connection's `base_url`. There is no update: changing `scim_connection_id` or `expires_at` replaces the token, and the old one stops working when it is destroyed. To rotate, add a second token, move the directory to it, then remove the first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The token Entra ID authenticates with, valid for a year. The secret is
# kept in state: protect the state as you would the token.
resource "authwise_scim_token" "entra" {
  realm_id           = authwise_realm.staff.realm_id
  scim_connection_id = authwise_scim_connection.entra.scim_connection_id
  expires_at         = "2027-11-16T00:00:00Z"
}

# What to paste into Entra ID as the Secret Token.
output "scim_secret" {
  value     = authwise_scim_token.entra.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scim_connection_id` (String)

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) `expires_at` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `keepers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values that replace the resource when any of them changes, never sent to the API. Change one to rotate: with `create_before_destroy`, the successor is created before this one is deleted.
- `realm_id` (String) Parent identifier `realm_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) `created_at` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `last_used_at` (String) `last_used_at` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `scim_token_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Returned once, by `CreateScimToken`, and kept in state: no read returns it, so a resource brought in with `terraform import` has none. Replace the resource (see `keepers`) to get a new one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name. The secret cannot be recovered: an imported
# token has no `secret` until a `keepers` change replaces it with a new one.
terraform import authwise_scim_token.entra tenants/t-01/realms/r-01/scim-tokens/st-01
```
